description: Fix review issues: north/west resize position drift, stale state.selected in multi-select drag, initialFitDone reset on layout change, and LocalGraph animation loop restart on hover
steps: In CanvasView.tsx CanvasNodeView startResize: Track prevDx and prevDy as local variables in the closure. Pass frame-relative deltas (currentTotal - prevTotal) to onResize instead of total deltas.
In CanvasView.tsx handleMouseDown: Mirror the selection logic for shift-click correctly when computing currentSelected - account for toggle-off case.
In GraphCanvas.tsx: Remove the useEffect that resets initialFitDone.current = false on [layout] dependency change.
In LocalGraph.tsx: Remove renderMini from the animation loop useEffect dependencies. Store the render function in a ref so it is always fresh without triggering effect cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: North/west resize handles move the node correctly without quadratic drift
Multi-select drag correctly handles shift-click toggle-off scenario
Auto zoom-to-fit only fires on initial mount, not on every filter toggle
LocalGraph animation loop does not restart on hover state changes
bun run lint passes with 0 errors
bunx --bun tsc --noEmit has no new errors in src/
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/OpenVault && bunx --bun tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v examples/
findings: All four review issues resolved. Resize now uses frame-relative deltas tracked via prevDx/prevDy closure variables. Multi-select drag mirrors shift-click toggle-off correctly. GraphCanvas auto-fit only fires on initial mount. LocalGraph animation loop uses a ref for renderMini to avoid restarts on hover. Lint passes with 0 errors, TypeScript passes (only pre-existing examples/ errors).
